fields.Name: W4 -> S2.1 #2
fields.Description: Gate G1.4 (phase 1, dataset W4, criterion S2.1 #2): PersonStatusNow on W4-pit s42 is excluded or flagged for 4 of 4 catalog algorithms, and every as-of assembled value equals the dated history's value at the row's decision date, 100% of rows (T4). W4's unit rows are decided before any lapse takes effect, so every row expects Active; the gate therefore also replays every lapser's Person.Status through the assembly's Record Changes reader: Lapsed the day after the lapse and Active the day before, for every lapser (3,288 of 3,288), and the Person.Status history's continuity check reports 0 mismatched records. It fails when the as-of assembler reads a record-changes column's current value instead of its history at the decision date (as-of mismatches appear), or when the history replay ignores Update rows (the lapse is never applied).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: PersonStatusNow refused (decision-date-before-change-history) for 4 of 4 catalog algorithms; Person.Status read as of each decision date equals the dated history on 100% of rows; every lapser replays as Lapsed the day after the lapse and Active the day before (3,288 of 3,288 each); Person.Status continuity: 0 records mismatched.
